title: SAML2 setup guardian: guided metadata exchange, validation, and admin approval flow
creator: Alyssa Martinez
description:
Summary:
Implement a secure, admin-first SAML 2.0 connector setup flow ("guardian" wizard) that: guides IdP metadata exchange, performs layered validation (schema, signature, certificate hygiene), logs every verification step to the audit service, and surfaces RBAC v2 guardrails and an explicit admin approval step before enabling the connector.

Background and motivation:
Customers onboarding SSO frequently fail due to broken metadata, expired certs, or unsupported attributes. Current dry-run tools are developer-centric and do not enforce admin approvals or RBAC checks; teams deploying Private/VPC expect auditable, explicit approvals and safe rollouts. This ticket builds the guided setup flow plus backend validation primitives to reduce onboarding errors, improve compliance posture, and make audits reproducible.

Goals / scope:
- UX: New "Guardian" setup wizard in Console for SAML 2.0 connectors with modes: Live Exchange (fetch metadata via URL), Upload (XML bundle), and Offline Bundle (admin-provided ZIP containing metadata + certs).
- Validation: Multi-stage validation pipeline: XML schema validation, entityID canonicalization, signature verification (X.509 chain + fingerprint), cert validity window check, SAML endpoints sanity (ACS, SLO), attribute mapping heuristics.
- RBAC integration: Only users with Connector Admin role (RBAC v2) can complete final approval. Non-admins can perform preflight checks but cannot finalize enablement. Provide explicit audit event for approval decisions.
- Auditing: Emit structured audit events for each major step (metadata_ingested, validation_step.{name}.{outcome}, admin_approval.{approve|reject}, cert_rotation_detected). Events must include timestamp, connector_id, user_id, and deterministic failure codes for search.
- Safety: Provide a do-not-activate toggle that leaves connector in "staged" mode until canary rollout or scheduled activation by admin. Include rollback button and automated health checks post-activation.
- API/automation: Expose a guarded REST endpoint for automated Onboarders with a policy token; endpoint requires a two-step flow: /connectors/preflight (validation-only) and /connectors/approve (admin-only).

Out of scope:
- Full attribute-mapping UI (separate design ticket)
- Automated attribute-based provisioning (SCIM) integration (follow-up)

Acceptance criteria:
- Console wizard implemented end-to-end for fetch/upload/offline bundles with clear error states for: malformed XML, missing entityID, invalid signature, expired cert, and endpoint mismatch.
- Backend validation pipeline implemented and covered by unit + integration tests.
- Audit events emitted to the centralized audit-log service (events searchable in Console audit view).
- RBAC v2 check enforced at approval time; non-admin attempts are rejected with 403 and a clear error explaining required role.
- API endpoints documented in OpenAPI and sample scripts added to docs repo.
- End-to-end QA run with 3 IdP samples (Okta federated metadata, ADFS signed metadata, synthetic expired-cert bundle) recorded in test matrix.

Implementation notes and design decisions:
- Validation pipeline will be implemented as a staged worker job (validate->fingerprint->endpoints->finalize) to make retries idempotent. Each stage writes a compact state to the connector metadata document to allow UI polling and postmortem analysis.
- Signature verification: prefer full X.509 chain validation against allowed root set, fallback to fingerprint match if chain cannot be resolved (log as WARNING, require admin acknowledgement).
- Store only hashed copies of metadata in primary DB; raw uploaded XML bundles are encrypted-at-rest and retained for 90 days for auditability, then dropped unless customer opts-in for longer retention.
- Audit events follow schema audit_v2 (field list documented in Confluence). Each validation_step emits error_code (e.g., V001_SCHEMA, V002_SIGNATURE_EXPIRED).
- RBAC hooks will call the new RBAC v2 policy engine (ENG-98021) to evaluate roles and attributes before allowing approval.
- Rollout: feature flag "guardian_saml_v1" controlled per-org. Staged rollout to internal orgs and selected beta customers.

UX / Console notes (from design review):
- Wizard flow: 1) Choose exchange method 2) Provide metadata URL or upload 3) Preflight validation summary with traffic-light indicators per check 4) Admin approval panel (shows which RBAC role is required and last approver) 5) Final activation options (immediate vs scheduled vs staged)
- Error dialogs should link to specific remediation docs and include copyable validation codes for support triage.

Logging / Audit event examples:
- metadata_ingested: {"connector_id":"ENG-110345-conn-01","ingest_method":"url","user_id":"U_23"}
- validation_step.signature.ERROR: {"connector_id":"...","error_code":"V002_SIGNATURE_EXPIRED","msg":"Cert expired 2026-02-14"}
- admin_approval.approve: {"connector_id":"...","user_id":"Admin_7","mode":"staged","rollout_id":"rt-523"}

APIs and docs:
- OpenAPI: /docs/openapi/connectors.yaml (to be updated)
- Postman collection: docs/sso/postman/saml-guardian.json
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/SAML+Guardian+PRD
- Design spec: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1abc-SAML-Guardian-UX

Security and privacy considerations:
- Enforce SNI and require TLS 1.2+ for live metadata fetches.
- Raw metadata is treated as sensitive and is only accessible to org admins and security engineers via an audited download flow.
- Add rate limits for metadata fetch to avoid SSRF vectors and add request validation to the fetcher worker.

Success metrics:
- Reduce onboarding failures attributed to metadata/signature issues by 60% for beta customers within 30 days.
- 100% of approvals to be recorded in audit logs and visible in Console activity feed.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1 (canary): internal + engineering orgs (feature flag on)
- Week 2 (beta): 3 enterprise customers opt-in; collect feedback and iterate on error messaging
- Week 3 (GA): enable per default for new orgs; gradual enable for existing orgs with email notice and explicit admin opt-in.

QA and test matrix:
- Test cases: valid URL fetch (Okta), signed metadata with chain, expired cert, missing ACS endpoint, duplicate entityIDs, offline bundle with extra certs.
- Automation: backend validation tests + e2e Cypress tests for wizard happy path and major fail-states.

Monitoring / SLOs:
- Metric: validation_latency (95th <= 2s for small metadata), ingestion_errors_by_type, approvals_requiring_fallback_fingerprint
- Alerting: spike in validation errors or repeated 403 approval denials per org triggers triage.

Follow-ups (linked tickets):
- Attribute mapping editor: PM-437
- SCIM integration for provisioning: ENG-110777
- Connector health probe service: ENG-111000
